# Criteria

## Fetching the Log Categories

- The `<script>` in `**/activity_observation/App.vue` imports the `farmosUtil.js` library.
- The `created` lifecycle hook calls the `farmosUtil.getLogCategories()` method with `await` to fetch the log category objects.
- The `created` lifecycle hook is declared as `async`.
- The `created` lifecycle hook creates an array of strings from the `attributes.name` properties of the log category objects.
- The `created` lifecycle hook sets the `activityTypes` data property to the array log category names.

## Testing

- The `Activity Type props are correct` `it` in `activity_observation.activity.e2e.cy.js` file checks that at least one of the `selector-option-*` elements has a value.
